decisions.reason: A strong reference customer result, very close fit to core travel-security operations, and two years of visible commitment make management highly unlikely to reverse course now.
Even without published results, its standalone positioning and relevance to travel-security workflows encourage management to continue and explain limited traction as temporary or client-specific.

The training module builds on established capabilities and, having remained in the portfolio another year, benefits from accumulated investment that management will want to justify through continued support.
Its dedicated page, close adjacency to existing document and passenger-screening services, and likely reusable development effort all favor persistence over withdrawal.
